summary: Yuba County tower listed as gone; a Forest Lookouts page gives Department of Defense and one 1951 entry. No build history, design or site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains

events.note: Only dated entry on the Forest Lookouts page; the page gives no other text beside the date

evidence.supports: county paired with Department of Defense
Walsh Mountain in Yuba County, tower, coordinates, listed gone

notes_for_editor: Only two pages describe this tower. The Forest Lookouts page has a 1951 heading and then an image where the rest of the entry would be; the image was not downloaded, so the story may be missing its construction history, and a human could read it. The FFLA California list is the only status source and gives no removal date. The Department of Defense line may name the owner rather than an operator; the agency fact rests on that single line. Three web searches found nothing else about the tower. Access is unknown, and no visitor note is included.
